popCulture.title: Ascalaphus (son of Ares)
popCulture.description: Minyan captain from Orchomenus, son of Ares — slain by Deiphobus at Troy. Not the underworld pomegranate witness.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: The Catalogue and the wall-fighting keep Ascalaphus among Ares' Minyan sons until Deiphobus' spear finds him.
